# Historical incumbent lineage fixtures

These original checksummed envelopes preserve the ten incumbent profiles'
creation ancestry and actual historical selections from the 2026-10-24 bot
experiment. They are copied without changes from its local artifact catalog.
Only the registry and its eight referenced creation/fitness/selection artifacts
are included. Historical scores lack current execution provenance and are
archival evidence only; they do not establish current promotion eligibility.

`../campaign_inventory.json` is the frozen strategic-only campaign inventory.
Tests import these tracked fixtures and the tracked Milestone 5 history so
they work without ignored `artifacts/` or any previous `localtmp/` run.
